name: Preline UI 5
licence: Dual: MIT + 'Preline UI Fair Use License' (no competing component library; attribution for sold derivative templates/themes). npm preline@5.0.0. Pro is commercial (not studied).
bestFor: HTML-first or any-framework apps needing JS plugins (advanced select, datatables, tree view, stepper)
studying the most granular semantic token set in the Tailwind world (navbar-*, sidebar-*, dropdown-*, per-state)
warm or muted alternative themes (harvest, cashmere, olive)
avoidFor: brand-led marketing with a strong voice
React-API-first projects (behaviour is vanilla JS plugins via hs-* classes)

families: default: Tailwind --font-sans (Inter on preline.co docs; not set in theme.css)
typography.notes: No custom type scale; Tailwind defaults. Inputs step 16px -> 14px at sm like Catalyst.

color.model: oklch (Tailwind palette + custom preline-khaki / preline-mauve / preline-avocado / avocado-soft ramps)

themes.default: blue-600 primary on gray neutrals; high contrast
themes.harvest: light: khaki neutrals (bg-1 khaki-50, fg khaki-800, border khaki-200), primary amber ramp at 700; dark: stone-800/900, primary 300. Vendor: warm, low-contrast, for long sessions
themes.retro: radius 0 everywhere (--radius-ui 0, all --radius-* 0), every border neutral-800, fuchsia-500 primary with neutral-800 primary-line. Vendor: bold, nostalgic, sharp
themes.ocean: cyan ramp primary at 600; dark gray-800/900
themes.autumn: stone neutrals, amber primary at 500; dark primary-200 on neutral-900
themes.moon: gray ramp as primary at 800 (dark: white primary); deep navy, low saturation, night-friendly
themes.cashmere: stone neutrals, preline-mauve primary at 600 (dark 400); dusty rose, quietly premium
themes.olive: avocado-soft neutrals, avocado primary at 600; muted green, grounded

color.darkMode: .dark class re-maps the semantic set; themes are activated by data-theme='theme-<name>' on :root and each theme ships its own dark block.
color.contrastNotes: Harvest, cashmere and olive deliberately lower contrast (vendor copy says 'low-contrast, eye-friendly'); verify muted-foreground (khaki/stone-400) against AA for body text.

radius.rule: Buttons and inputs rounded-lg (8px); docs chips rounded-sm. Themes can zero all radii (retro) by overriding --radius-* and a --radius-ui utility hook.

shadows: Tailwind defaults; shadow-sm on active tab
depth.borders: 1px; border colour from a numbered 8-step line scale (line-1..8) so a component picks contrast by number

motion.durationsMs: unknown (component plugin CSS not studied in depth)
motion.notes: Behaviour in vanilla JS plugins (hs-dropdown, hs-overlay, hs-tab). v5 adds 'Animated Icons' in plain SVG + keyframes.

controlHeightsPx.computation: 20px line + py-3 x2 + 2px border, computed from docs classes

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High in tokens: every interactive role has -hover, -focus, -active (and primary -checked) tokens, so state colours are themeable. Disabled = opacity-50 + pointer-events-none.

tokenArchitecture: Three layers: Tailwind palette -> :root semantic vars (--primary, --layer, --surface, --navbar-nav-hover...) -> @theme inline maps to utilities (bg-primary, border-layer-line). ~170 semantic tokens including per-region sets (navbar, navbar-1, navbar-2, sidebar x3, card, dropdown, select, overlay, popover, tooltip, table, footer, scrollbar, chart x10).
distinctiveness: Per-state and per-region tokens: a theme can recolour 'sidebar nav hover' without touching buttons. Themes also retune the neutral family (khaki, mauve, avocado-soft) rather than only the accent, which is what makes harvest/olive feel different.
weaknesses: Token explosion (~170) is hard to author by hand
Default theme is generic blue-600 + gray
Fair-use clause restricts building a competing library
takeaways: Retint the neutrals, not just the accent: a khaki or avocado-soft neutral ramp changes temperature more than any brand colour.
Tokenise state per role (-hover/-focus/-active/-checked) so themes own interaction colour.
A 'retro' theme is mostly radius 0 + every border at the foreground colour: brutalism as two knobs.
provenance: mixed (theme.css from npm preline@5.0.0 and css/themes/*.css from GitHub main; sizes computed from docs markup)
